explanation: The coup of 25 April 1974 ended the war and the empire together. Within a year Lisbon had recognised the liberation movements as the parties it would hand power to, and in São Tomé and Príncipe that was the MLSTP, which had never had a war to fight. The election of 7 and 8 July 1975 is what that recognition looked like on the ground: a single legal list choosing the assembly that would take independence four days later. Without the revolution there is neither ballot nor assembly — the Estado Novo had conceded neither, and in the islands it had not been asked to.
